name: Precise Records, Unstable Meanings: Measurement Validity and Unsupported Claims Derived from AI Agent Telemetry
headline: Precise Records, Unstable Meanings: Measurement Validity and Unsupported Claims Derived from AI Agent Telemetry
description: This preprint presents a twelve-week naturalistic audit of AI agent telemetry and measurement validity. It shows how transcript files, claims ledgers, anomaly scores, agent traces, and operational records can support record-level measurements without establishing logical-session duration, completed tasks, correct outcomes, or failure prevalence. It introduces a Telemetry-to-Claim Gate for producer provenance, analytical unit, construct, population, observation window, denominator, validation evidence, and sensitivity before telemetry is used in agent evaluation, observability, governance, or system redesign.
